verdict.rationale: Multichannel inboxes are a fair question for an email or team-inbox product, but the evidence only documents Gmail and Outlook email accounts. 'Social network updates' refers to auto-labeling or archiving notification emails, not handling social channels. Nothing shows SMS, WhatsApp, social or live-chat conversations handled in the inbox.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
